kakha13-think-like-me-root.description: Personal engineering rules and reasoning patterns the user has curated over time. Consult BEFORE writing, modifying, debugging, or designing any technical feature — rules often cover domain-specific gotchas (e.g., mobile audio timers need background mode) that generic answers miss. Also triggers on `/learn-this`, "learn this", "remember this", or `/new-rule` to capture new rules, and on detected corrections to previously proposed code.
